end.summary:
Ayaan counted sides of 2D shapes, including shapes in different positions; this was shown on a new-situation question.
Ayaan counted corners, including squares, rectangles, triangles, and circles; this was shown on a new-situation question.
Ayaan practised naming shapes from their sides and corners; this is partly checked and needs more varied examples next time.
Ayaan once counted a square’s first side twice, then corrected it by recounting and stating that a square has 4 sides.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners of shapes in different sizes and positions. Ayaan used the shape’s lines and corners to reason, and corrected the mix-up of counting one side twice by starting again and counting four sides. Naming a shape from its sides and corners still needs more practice; at home, show shapes turned in different directions and ask Ayaan to count each side and corner once.
